target_moa.text: Motixafortide is a selective antagonist/inhibitor of the C-X-C motif chemokine receptor 4 (CXCR4) that blocks binding of its ligand SDF-1α/CXCL12; CXCR4-SDF-1α signaling is involved in the trafficking and homing of hematopoietic stem cells to the marrow, and blockade mobilizes HSCs to peripheral blood.

citations.quote: Motixafortide (proposed propriety name APHEXDA) is a synthetic peptide and an inhibitor of the C-X-C motif chemokine receptor 4 (CXCR4) and blocks the binding of its cognate ligand, stromal-derived factor-1\alpha (SDF-1\alpha)/C-X-C motif chemokine ligand 12 (CXCL12). SDF-1\alpha and CXCR4 are recognized to play a role in the trafficking and homing of human hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) to the m
Motixafortide is a selective antagonist of CXCR4 and blocks the binding between CXCR4 and its endogenous ligand, stromal-derived factor-1 (SDF-1)/CXCL12.
Motixafortide (also called BL-8040 or BKT-140) is a synthetic cyclic peptide containing 14 amino acids with 3 unnatural amino acids (D-lysine, L-2-naphthylalanine, and L-citrulline).
